macros.name: bshyp
macros.doc: The \bshyp command can be used to print a backslash and have following hyphenation.

macros.name: colonhyp
macros.doc: The \colonhyp command can be used to print a colon and have following hyphenation.

macros.name: dothyp
macros.doc: The \dothyp command can be used to print a period (full stop) and have following hyphenation.

macros.name: fshyp
macros.doc: The \fshyp command can be used to print a forward slash and have following hyphenation.

macros.name: hyp
macros.doc: The \hyp command is like the other \...hyp commands, only it typesets a hyphen and allows full automatic hyphenation of the other words forming the compound word.

macros.name: nhttfamily
macros.doc: The \nhttfamily declaration is a companion to the \textnhtt command and is analagous to the \ttfamily declaration in that it prevents any hyphenation of TT fonts.

macros.name: nohyphens
macros.doc: The command \nohyphens{⟨text⟩} will typeset ⟨text⟩ without any automatic hyphenation.

macros.name: textnhtt
macros.doc: The command \textnhtt{⟨text⟩} will typeset ⟨text⟩ in the default TT font with no automatic hyphenation.
